description: Ritningssymboler för ventiler m m. For a backventil the flow direction runs from the unmarked field to the marked field. For a trevägsventil the marked fields indicate the controllable valve opening.

entries.symbol_description: Two opposed triangles (bowtie) in the pipe run.
entries.older_symbol: Filled dot with a short stem.

entries.symbol_description: Single triangle on a stem in the pipe run.
Bowtie with a third branch on a stem.
entries.older_symbol: Filled dot with a stem on a tee.

entries.symbol_description: Bowtie with a marked field and a third branch.
entries.older_symbol: Filled triangle with an arrow stem.

entries.symbol_description: Four-way cross of triangles with marked fields.
Bowtie with one field filled. Flow runs from the unmarked to the marked field.
entries.older_symbol: Triangle against a bar, filled or open.

entries.symbol_description: Bowtie with a downward arrow on the stem.
Short perpendicular stem with a dot at the pipe.
Inverted hook on a stem rising from the pipe.
Comb of short vertical strokes on the pipe.
Two dots on the pipe joined by a bracket to a single outlet stem.
